_about: Question sets for the knowledge exam (tests/scale_bench/exam.py), added to questions.json's paraphrase, exact and old33. Gold = exact note titles (a guide's gold may be its short name). typo: misspelled or one-line vague. negative: the answer is not in the knowledge base (no gold). multihop: needs two notes, the second linked from the first ([[link]]); 'pair' is [linking note, linked note]. stale: the corpus builder writes 'new' (a dated note that says it supersedes 'old' and changes one fact); the newer note should rank above the older. guide: a procedure whose right answer is a guide. scope: about this game's own notes (the corpus's game project, 'game'); asked with the game project set. 'answers' is the fixed end-to-end answer set: 2-4 key facts per question, each checked against the gold note, the wrong facts a distractor, the stale note or a sloppy reading would give, and what is expected ('answer', 'not_found' or 'guide').

stale.q: what is the maximum Range of a PointLight or SpotLight now

new.title: Light Range Cap Raised - November 2026 Update
new.body: The engine update of 12 November 2026 raised the clamp on light Range. PointLight, SpotLight and SurfaceLight Range is now capped at 240 studs (it was 120). Brightness still does not extend reach; raise Range instead. Lights past 120 studs cost more on phones, so keep long-range lights to one or two hero lights per view.

stale.q: what is the most players a place can have and still get voice chat

new.title: Voice Chat Server Size - November 2026 Change
new.fact_old: voice needs max players at or below 100
new.fact_new: voice works with max players up to 150
new.body: Since 5 November 2026 voice chat is available in places with a maximum of up to 150 players (the old limit was 100). Above 150, voice is still silently absent and players report it as broken, so keep max players at or below 150 when voice is part of the game.

stale.q: how many outbound HttpService requests per minute can one server make

new.title: HttpService Request Limit - 2026 Revision
new.fact_old: 500 external requests per minute per server
new.fact_new: 1000 external requests per minute per server
new.body: Roblox doubled the HttpService budget on 18 November 2026: a server may now send 1000 external requests per minute (it was 500). Open Cloud calls keep their separate 2500 per minute. Batch per-player events anyway: one request per player event still runs into the limit in a full server.

stale.q: how many triangles can one mesh have before I have to split it

new.title: Mesh Triangle Limit - Raised in 2026
new.body: From 9 November 2026 a single MeshPart may hold up to 40,000 triangles (it was 20,000). Above 40,000, split by material or body part, or decimate. The budget in the brief still decides the count: the limit is a ceiling, not a target.

stale.q: how much of the frame should an item icon fill

new.title: Icon Framing Standard - Revised
new.body: The icon framing standard changed on 2 November 2026: icons now fill 76% of the frame (it was 82%), still on a 45-degree diagonal and centred, so the new rarity badge in the corner never overlaps the item. Fill is still computed from bounds, never framed by hand.

stale.q: what Ackermann amount should our cars use
stale.old: Steering Geometry and Arcade Drifting - Ackermann, Slip and Grip Tuning

new.title: Ackermann Standard for Our Cars
new.fact_new: Ackermann amount fixed at 0.8 for every car
new.body: Decided on 15 November 2026 after the handling playtest: every car uses an Ackermann amount of exactly 0.8 (the old guidance allowed anything from 0.6 to 1). Lock still falls with speed and the steering angle stays rate-limited.

stale.q: how many stacked water layers can fake water use

new.title: Fake Water Layers - Phone Rule
new.body: From 20 November 2026 fake water uses one layer only (it was two at most): the second layer doubled overdraw on phones in the profiling pass. Depth comes from a gradient on that one layer, ripples scroll on it, and foam and buried edges hide its border.

stale.q: on a gamepad, which buttons switch menu tabs

new.title: Gamepad Tab Switching - New Mapping
new.fact_new: the D-pad left and right switch tabs; shoulder buttons zoom the camera
new.body: New mapping, 11 November 2026: tabs in every menu are switched with D-pad left and right. The shoulder buttons (LB and RB) no longer switch tabs; they are kept for camera zoom. Initial selection, trapped navigation, B to close and focus restore are unchanged.

stale.q: how long before the hit must a boss's tracking attack commit

new.title: Boss Commit Window - Updated Minimum
new.fact_old: commit at least 0.45 s before the hit
new.fact_new: commit at least 0.6 s before the hit
new.body: Raised on 8 November 2026 after phone playtests: a boss's tracking attack must lock and commit at least 0.6 s before the hit (it was 0.45 s). Phone players with 100 ms or more of latency could not react inside the old window.

stale.q: what is the limit on how many Highlights can be on screen at once

new.title: Highlight Limit - Current Budget
new.fact_new: the team budget is 16 simultaneous highlights
new.body: Our budget since 14 November 2026: at most 16 Highlights at once in any view (old code budgeted against 31). Disabled Highlights still take a slot, so destroy unused ones, and flash a persistent Highlight's transparency instead of creating new ones.

game.name: Skystone Isles
game.GAME.md:
# Skystone Isles

## One-line pitch
Hop between floating islands, hatch pets and fight sky pirates with friends.

## Pillars
- Pets you hatch and evolve
- Short island-hopping sessions on phones
- Co-op pirate raids

## Core loop
Collect coins on islands, hatch eggs, raid pirate ships for gems, unlock the next island.

notes.Autosave Rules.md:
---
kind: rule
---
# Autosave Rules

Skystone Isles autosaves every player profile every 90 seconds, and saves at once after every shop purchase and every egg hatch. The session lock lease is 5 minutes, so the 90 second autosave always renews it. On BindToClose we save every player in parallel and wait at most 25 seconds.
notes.Pet Hatch Odds.md:
---
kind: rule
---
# Pet Hatch Odds

In Skystone Isles a Mythic pet hatches with a 1 in 2,500 chance from a Sky Egg. Pity guarantees a Mythic on the 3,000th Sky Egg without one; the pity counter is saved in the profile and resets when any Mythic hatches. Legendary pets are 1 in 400.
notes.HUD Layout Decisions.md:
---
kind: rule
---
# HUD Layout Decisions

The coin counter sits top-left, 24 px inside the safe area. The gem counter sits under it. The quest tracker is on the right side and collapses to an icon on phones. Nothing goes bottom-centre: the jump button and the hotbar live there on phones.
notes.Combat Numbers.md:
---
kind: rule
---
# Combat Numbers

The starter sword deals 12 base damage, with a swing cooldown of 0.4 seconds. Critical hits multiply damage by 1.5 and happen on 10% of swings. Sky pirates have 120 health on the first island and 15% more on each later island.

facts: Kick the player from all servers and wait for the session lock to be released before removing data
Find every data store and key format the code uses, including legacy reads, so no copy survives
Dump the current values to disk before removing them
wrong: Simply call RemoveAsync while the player is online
Use SetAsync to overwrite the save with an empty table while they play

facts: Use a server-side bounds sweep rather than relying only on Touched on a kill plane
Return players to a server-tracked last safe position
Put boundary walls in their own collision group so combat raycasts ignore them
wrong: Only rely on a Touched kill plane
Use thin invisible walls

facts: Each hit has one strength value from which stop, trauma and kick are derived
Light hits get no hit-stop and no shake
Important stops should be 66 ms or more because 50 ms is only 1-2 frames at 30 fps
wrong: Every hit, including light hits, should freeze and shake

facts: Use a pity system that guarantees the rare item after a number of failed tries
Keep drops in named, versioned drop tables as data
Keep weighted picks and independent chances in separate fields
wrong: Odds scattered in enemy scripts

facts: Keep the counter in a DataStore key updated only with UpdateAsync, enforcing supply inside the transform
Every mint has a stable idempotency id (such as the PurchaseId)
MemoryStore may only mirror the counter, never be its authority
wrong: Use GetAsync then SetAsync for the counter
Use MemoryStore as the counter

facts: Lower and cap AFK income
Detect activity on the server from several observable signals, not movement alone
Warn before an idle kick and exempt private and reserved servers
wrong: Kick anyone who has not moved, with no warning

facts: Huge values lose precision; clamp and check isfinite before saving so inf and NaN never reach the profile
Every stored number needs a container type whose limit is above its design maximum
Scale rewards with progress so small bonuses are not lost below precision
wrong: Doubles are exact at any size

facts: The server sends a seed, position and strike time so every client renders the identical bolt
The strike lasts under about 0.3 s with a flicker
Thunder is delayed after the flash
wrong: Each client randomises its own bolt

facts: Intercept lethal damage in the damage core and down the player instead of letting Health reach 0
The server owns a LifeState attribute
Revives go through a ProximityPrompt with server checks, and bleed-out uses server timestamps
wrong: Let Health hit 0 and then undo the death
Let the client report the revive

facts: Use attack tokens: a token budget per target with costs per attack type
A coordinator assigns roles such as pinner, flanker, suppressor and waiter
Tokens are released on every exit path
wrong: A flat token count with no costs or priority

facts: Disable the built-in displays (DisplayDistanceType = None) where custom tags exist
Create tags with a client-side tag manager, not on the server
Use tiers, declutter and a slow refresh, and never show enemy tags through walls
wrong: Create nametags on the server
Give enemy tags AlwaysOnTop

facts: Use the Developer Exchange (DevEx) to exchange earned Robux for real money
The standard rate is 0.0038 USD per earned Robux
Purchased Robux cannot be exchanged; you need a verified email and the right tax form
wrong: Any Robux you hold can be cashed out
The rate is 0.0054 USD for all Robux

facts: Sliders use TranslateLine with bounds and constraint-based snapping
Slot drags use a custom response style with a top-level ghost and GetGuiObjectsAtPosition
Moves are server-validated intents
wrong: Snap after release instead of during the drag

facts: Hide the HUD, chat bubbles and nametags, wait a frame, then capture
Save and share only from explicit buttons
Leash the free camera and restore it on every exit path
wrong: Capture with the toolbar visible

facts: Do not rely only on the FallenPartsDestroyHeight kill plane or Touched; sweep player positions on the server
Recover players to a server-tracked last safe position
wrong: Only rely on a Touched kill plane

facts: Grant only in ProcessReceipt, never from client signals like PromptProductPurchaseFinished
Save first, then return PurchaseGranted
Return NotProcessedYet when the player is not in the server, the product is unknown or the save failed
wrong: Grant in PromptProductPurchaseFinished
Return PurchaseGranted before saving

facts: Write and check the lease inside the same UpdateAsync as the data
Fence every save with a per-session token
The autosave interval is shorter than the lease and renews it
wrong: Use SetAsync for player saves

facts: Use plain mode: string.find(s, text, 1, true), because . and - are pattern characters
Alternatively escape the magic characters with % (for example %. matches a literal dot)
wrong: Escape nothing; dots match literally in Lua patterns

facts: Give boss NPCs server ownership with SetNetworkOwner(nil) after spawn
Anchored parts are always server-owned; do not call SetNetworkOwner on them
wrong: Leave boss NPCs on automatic ownership

facts: LightInfluence defaults to 1 on Studio insert, which darkens effects in caves
Set LightInfluence explicitly, usually to 0, on every VFX emitter
wrong: Raise Brightness to fix dark caves

facts: Simulate fast projectiles as points with swept casts, not unanchored parts with Touched
The server validates origin, time, line of sight and plausibility
wrong: Use an unanchored part with Touched for bullets
Trust the client to say who it hit

facts: WinchForce must be greater than mass times gravity, with headroom
Use a positive WinchSpeed and change WinchTarget to reel out
wrong: Use a negative WinchSpeed to reel out

facts: Quest definitions live in data with permanent ids, driven by a signal bus
Rewards are frozen when the quest is dealt
Resets use server UTC period keys
wrong: Compute rewards at claim time
Use the client's time for resets

facts: Disconnect connections to long-lived signals on teardown, for example with a cleanup bag
Disconnect per-character Heartbeat connections on death or CharacterRemoving and clear per-player tables on PlayerRemoving
wrong: Connections are garbage collected automatically when the object is gone

facts: The purchase log holds the purchase id, product key, real Robux spent, grant contents and time
The grant happens in ProcessReceipt only
wrong: Use the webhook's Robux amount as the revenue lost
Grant in PromptProductPurchaseFinished

facts: Show a neutral ban message with a case id, not the specific detection
Consequences require two detection categories unless a certain signal fired
wrong: Tell them exactly what was detected, e.g. speed detected
Ban on the first signal from one detector

facts: Render at a delay of 2 to 3 snapshot intervals
Every buffer format starts with a version byte
wrong: A delay of one interval
Set position on receipt

facts: Interactable models are Atomic (Persistent only for tiny essentials)
Call RequestStreamAroundAsync on the destination before moving the player
wrong: Make many models Persistent
Turn streaming off

facts: Kill switches turn off risky systems without a rollback
Every MemoryStore write gets the shortest sensible expiration, and processed items are removed
wrong: Use long TTLs just in case
Treat MemoryStore as durable

facts: Set LightInfluence explicitly, usually 0
Use a governor with a global cap and give onlookers half or less of the caster's budget
wrong: Leave LightInfluence at the default 1

facts: The autosave interval is shorter than the lease and renews it
With a session lock, the destination server waits until the source releases the lock
wrong: Autosave less often than the lease length

facts: The day boundary is a server-side integer from UTC time with an explicit offset
Never more than one automatic pop-up at a time
wrong: Use the client's os.time() for the day
Compare timestamps instead of day indexes

facts: The driver owns the vehicle: assign on sit and reset on exit
Test ownership bugs with two or more clients
wrong: Test ownership with one client
Keep the vehicle server-owned while driving

facts: The cadence cap is derived from the weapon or ability data
Rate limit first, before any expensive lookup
wrong: Accept every click
Do the expensive lookup before the rate limit

facts: Light Range is now capped at 240 studs (raised from 120 in the November 2026 update)
Brightness does not extend a light's reach; raise Range instead
wrong: Range is capped at 120 studs

facts: Voice chat works in places with up to 150 max players (raised from 100)
Above 150 max players voice is silently absent, so keep max players at or below 150 when voice matters
wrong: Voice needs max players at or below 100

facts: One server may send 1000 external HttpService requests per minute
Open Cloud calls have a separate 2500 per minute
wrong: 500 external requests per minute per server

facts: One mesh may now hold up to 40,000 triangles; split or decimate above that
Above the limit, split the mesh by material or body part, or decimate it
wrong: One mesh at most 20,000 triangles

facts: Icons fill 76% of the frame
Fill is computed from bounds, centred on a 45-degree diagonal
wrong: Icons fill 82% of the frame

facts: Every car uses an Ackermann amount of exactly 0.8
Steering lock still falls with speed and the steering angle stays rate-limited
wrong: An Ackermann amount anywhere from 0.6 to 1

facts: Tracking attacks commit at least 0.6 s before the hit
The window was widened because phone players with 100 ms or more of latency could not react in time
wrong: Commit at least 0.45 s before the hit

facts: The team budget is at most 16 Highlights at once
Destroy unused Highlights because disabled ones still take a slot
wrong: The budget is 31 simultaneous highlights

facts: Our game autosaves every 90 seconds
It also saves at once after every shop purchase and egg hatch
wrong: Autosave every 60 seconds

facts: A Mythic pet is a 1 in 2,500 chance from a Sky Egg
Pity guarantees a Mythic on the 3,000th Sky Egg without one
The starter sword deals 12 base damage
The swing cooldown is 0.4 seconds
